question: If a line has direction ratios $a,b,c$ and passes through $A(1,2,3)$, the position vector of any point on the line can be written as
explanation:
The vector equation of a line is $\vec r = \vec a + \lambda \vec b$.

Here $\vec a$ is the position vector of the point $(1,2,3)$ and $\vec b$ is the direction vector $(a,b,c)$.

Thus the equation becomes $(1\hat i + 2\hat j + 3\hat k) + \lambda(a\hat i + b\hat j + c\hat k)$.

Hence option A is correct.
